title: Autism & Neurodiversity Home Support in Sandwell & Dudley | Everyday Care Plus
description: Structured, sensory-aware home support for autistic and neurodivergent adults in Sandwell and Dudley. Discuss personalised care with Everyday Care Plus.
intro: We provide structured, sensory-aware support designed around each individual’s preferences, communication style, routines, and goals.

sections.heading: A personalised approach
sections.body: Support is developed with the individual, their family, and relevant professionals where appropriate. We focus on predictability, respectful communication, and continuity.

sections.heading: Discuss your needs
sections.body: An initial conversation helps us understand the kind of support that may be helpful and whether our service is the right fit.
